aoi.description: Select the area to cover with FRA hexagons: an administrative unit, a vector file, a drawn shape, points or an Earth Engine asset.

error.empty: The AOI has no geometry. Pick another area.
error.no_polygon: The AOI has no polygon area. Use a polygon or point AOI.
error.antimeridian: The AOI crosses the 180° meridian. Split it into two parts, one on each side of 180°, and generate each one. The cells straddling 180° come with the part that ends at +180°.
error.fetch: Could not read the AOI geometry: {error}

grid.caption: Aperture-3 cells don't nest: finer cells are linked to FRA cells with fra_r17_id. The FRA correction is validated at r17 only.
grid.name_hint: Letters, digits, _ and - only. It is also the folder name.

name_error.invalid: Use letters, digits, _ and - only, starting with a letter or digit.

grid.name_exists: A grid with this name exists. Generating replaces its folder.
grid.name_taken: A folder with this name exists and was not made by this app. Choose another name.
grid.shp_hint: Max 2 GB per file (~4M cells), 10-character field names, no embedded metadata.
grid.shp_disabled: Shapefile is unavailable above 4,000,000 estimated cells.
grid.blocked_hint: About {cells} cells is over the 10,000,000 limit. Use a smaller AOI or a coarser level.
grid.warn_message: About {cells} cells. This can take several minutes and about {size} of disk.
grid.overwrite_message: The folder {name} already exists. It is replaced once the new grid is complete.
grid.cancelled: Grid generation cancelled. No files were kept.
grid.engine_missing: DGGRID binary not found: reinstall the module environment.
grid.disk_full: Not enough disk space to write {name}.
grid.preview_too_large: Map preview is limited to 50,000 cells.

outputs.title: Generated grids
outputs.empty: No grids yet. Generate one in the Grid tab.
outputs.delete_message: The folder {name} and all its files ({size}) will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
